# The AAT shaping test cases of sdl3-ttf (src/tests/aat.rs), which the C
# program that made aat_reference.txt runs too. A `font FILE` line
# starts the cases of a font in fonts/; a case is `case DIR SCRIPT LANG
# PTEM FEATURES TEXT`, tab-separated: the direction (ltr, rtl, ttb, btt),
# the ISO 15924 script and the BCP 47 language of the buffer, the font's
# point size for tracking (hb_font_set_ptem), the features (comma-
# separated, in hb_feature_from_string's syntax, limited to [+-]tag,
# tag=N and tag[A:B]=N), `-` for none, and the text, with `\xNN` escapes
# for bytes. Cases without features and point size also go through
# SDL_ttf's own functions. The two `corrupt` lines of a font are the
# cases shaped with its AAT tables corrupted.
font DejaVuSans-AAT-morx.ttf
case	-	-	-	-	-	axyb xaz xpqrw xv xx
case	-	-	-	-	-	coke cat c ec ck
case	-	-	-	-	-	fi fl ffi ffl ff fff fiffl ffa f
case	-	-	-	-	-	jam mn mhn q h mhmh
case	-	-	-	-	-	VaW WaV VV
case	-	-	-	-	-liga	office fluffy
case	-	-	-	-	liga[2:5]=0	office office
case	-	-	-	-	smcp	abcde ABC good
case	-	-	-	-	ss01	hello world
case	-	-	-	-	ss02,ss03	0123456789 nnn
case	-	-	-	-	ss04	rst first
case	rtl	-	-	-	ss05	xyz axyb
case	rtl	-	-	-	-	axyb fi coke
case	-	-	-	-	aalt=1	gig
case	-	-	-	-	aalt=2	gig
case	-	-	-	-	aalt=1,aalt=2	gig
case	-	-	-	-	aalt	gig
case	-	-	tr	-	-	fit iki
case	-	-	tr-TR	-	-	fit iki
case	-	-	en	-	-	fit tut
case	-	-	-	-	dlig	zebra
case	-	-	-	-	-calt	coke
case	-	-	-	-	calt[1:3]=0	coke coke
case	-	-	-	-	smcp[0:2],liga=0	abcfi abcfi
case	ttb	-	-	-	-	abc axy fi
case	btt	-	-	-	-	abc axy
case	-	-	-	-	-	pad pud tut
case	-	-	-	-	-	ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffi
case	-	-	-	-	-	fí fí́ ffí x\xcc\x81y
case	-	-	-	-	-	f c x m
corrupt	-	-	-	-	-	axyb coke fi ffl jam mhn VaW
corrupt	-	-	tr	-	smcp,ss04	fit abc rst gig
font DejaVuSans-AAT-mort.ttf
case	-	-	-	-	-	axyb xaz xpqrw xv xx
case	-	-	-	-	-	coke cat c ec ck
case	-	-	-	-	-	fi fl ffi ffl ff fff fiffl ffa f
case	-	-	-	-	-	jam mn mhn q h mhmh
case	-	-	-	-	-liga	office fluffy
case	-	-	-	-	smcp	abcde good
case	-	-	-	-	ss01,ss04	hello rst
case	-	-	tr	-	-	fit
case	-	-	-	-	-	AVATAR TOWER To AWAY TWo
case	-	-	-	-	-kern	AVATAR TOWER
case	-	-	-	-	-	^x_ ^ x^y
case	-	-	-	-	-	LT Pa Fo Ya Wa We Yo
case	ttb	-	-	-	-	AV LT
case	rtl	-	-	-	-	AVATAR axyb
corrupt	-	-	-	-	-	axyb coke fi ffl jam AVATAR TWo
corrupt	-	-	-	-	smcp	abcde LT Wa ^x_
font DejaVuSans-AAT-kerx.ttf
case	-	-	-	-	-	AVA To LT AA
case	-	-	-	-	-	Wa Ye WaYe
case	-	-	-	-	-	AV TWo TAWV AWV
case	-	-	-	-	-	^ _ x^ ^_^
case	-	-	-	-	-	LT Pa Fo Ya Lo
case	-	-	-	-	-	a. e, o: a.e x.
case	-	-	-	-	-	HI OQ IH HO OO
case	-	-	-	-	-	DE ED DD EE
case	-	-	-	-	-kern	AVA To LT
case	ttb	-	-	-	-	AV LT
case	rtl	-	-	-	-	AV TWo
case	-	-	-	8	-	Tracking
case	-	-	-	12	-	Tracking
case	-	-	-	16	-	Tracking
case	-	-	-	36	-	Tracking
case	-	-	-	48	-	Tracking
case	-	-	-	16	-trak	Tracking
case	ttb	-	-	16	-	Tracking
case	-	-	-	20	-	é á̈ ñ
corrupt	-	-	-	16	-	AVA To LT Wa AWV TWo
corrupt	-	-	-	12	-	^_ LT a. e, o: HI OQ
font DejaVuSans-AAT-kernot.ttf
case	-	-	-	-	-	AVATAR TOWER To AWAY TWo
case	-	-	-	-	-kern	AVATAR TOWER
case	-	-	-	-	-	^x_ ^ x^y
case	-	-	-	-	-	LT Pa Fo Ya
case	ttb	-	-	-	-	AV LT
corrupt	-	-	-	-	-	AVATAR TOWER TWo
corrupt	-	-	-	-	-	^x_ LT Pa
font NotoSans-AAT.ttf
case	-	-	-	-	-	office affine fluffy ffl ffi
case	-	-	-	-	-	coke jam mhn axyb
case	-	-	-	-	-liga	office
case	ttb	-	-	-	-	office coke
case	rtl	-	-	-	-	office axyb
case	-	-	-	-	-	é ạ̈ ñ q̣̇ fí
corrupt	-	-	-	-	-	office affine coke jam
corrupt	ttb	-	-	-	-	office coke
font NotoSans-Unhinted-AAT.ttf
case	-	-	-	-	-	office affine AVATAR To
case	-	-	-	10	-	office To
case	-	-	-	15	-	office To
case	-	-	-	30	-	office To
case	ttb	-	-	-	-	office AV
corrupt	-	-	-	15	-	office AVATAR To Wa
corrupt	-	-	-	-	-	coke jam axyb
